title: Fly Gui By ItzXery
features:
Fly GUI – By ItzXery  
====================

Description:
Fly GUI by ItzXery is a lightweight and stable flight system designed for Roblox executors.  
The GUI provides smooth movement, easy controls, and optimized performance without revealing  
internal script construction or development methods. The system is intended to be simple,  
fast, and compatible with most games.

Main Purpose:
The main purpose of this Fly GUI is to allow the player to move freely in the air with  
smooth directional control. The script focuses on stable flight, easy activation,  
and safe movement handling, making it ideal for exploration, obby shortcuts, or  
free-camera style movement.

Key Functions:
• Enables the player to fly with adjustable speed  
• Provides a clean and minimal GUI for toggling fly mode  
• Uses smooth directional input (W A S D or mobile joystick)  
• Keeps movement stable to avoid shaking or force glitches  
• Supports both PC and Mobile controls  
• Auto-disables safely when the GUI is closed  
• Lightweight performance so it doesn’t impact FPS heavily

New Features:
• Updated speed controller for smoother acceleration  
• Improved movement stability and reduced drifting  
• Better mobile optimization for Android users  
• New auto-align system that keeps flight direction accurate  
• Enhanced compatibility with more games  
• GUI redesign for cleaner buttons and easier access  
• Emergency Stop button (instantly disables fly mode if needed)

Notes:
This explanation does not show how the script was built internally and does not reveal  
its code structure. It only describes the purpose, functions, and new features of  
Fly GUI By ItzXery.
